interpretation.sourceUiEvidence: Selected local file hashes identify the edited local snapshot only. Presence and hash equality do not establish rendering/audio correctness or equivalence to the separately verified remote commit.

interpretation.statuses: Every game and QA check remains UNVERIFIED; no DONE claim.
interpretation.scopeBoundary: Graphics, nonmonetary controls, audio, motion and isolated mock UI recovery only. Financial operations and production changes are outside this matrix.

checkDefinitions.task: Confirm the exact official free-demo identity, visible version, orientation and viewport; do not substitute another title.
Inspect loading and sound-consent views in the isolated free-play build; count active canvases and remove retained screenshot or stale overlay obstruction.
Compare dedicated backgrounds, symbol crops, logos, multiplier displays and button sprites with the same official-demo state.

Record repeated simulated rounds and intermediate/terminal frames; check stable symbol identity, continuous position, observed stop sequence and no final-frame swap. Do not assume identical timing across games.
Inspect visible controls/modals and measured hit areas; verify one response per pointer/touch. BET is tested only as a displayed local UI value.
Where AUTO exists, inspect its official confirmation flow and verify no simulated round starts before the visible start action.
Compare accessible reference cues and test mute, blur, visibility, pause and clean resume with local audio; prevent overlapping instances.
Use network-isolated mocks for delayed, rejected and malformed simulated results; test UI recovery without account or financial requests.
Inspect narrow portrait, short landscape and wide layouts; verify readable controls, no unintended overlaps, clipping or obstructed close actions.
Attach game-specific captures and test output to exact source hashes; keep UNVERIFIED until relevant evidence is reviewed.
